notes.title: V0.2.1 patch
notes.notes: Due to how ragdoll implementation was done, it prevented the kill counter from rising. This resulted in the game being impossible to win, but this patch rectifies that matter. You may now continue your slaughter.

notes.title: V0.1.1 Bug fixing and changes
notes.notes:
V0.1.1 changes:
        * Addition of healing each night
	* Peasants knocked over from a lunge with a peasant in hand no longer stay on the ground
	* Hit marker sound added
	* Fix game over screen not showing cursor
	* Main menu backdrop updated with game logo and version number
	* Fixed camera snapping to head randomly
	* Fixed character animations breaking when pausing while moving
	* Guard attack damage reduced.
